entry.prompt: Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game: a mountain pony stable. One long, wide, low log barn, wider than tall, with a steep turf roof, two open stall doorways on the long side, a hay loft door and a wooden hitching rail, one blue banner.

style.suffix: Weathered dark timber, grey fieldstone footings, green turf or thatch roofs, carved crossed gable beams. Chunky low-poly shapes, hard edges, flat faces. Isolated building, no ground, no text, no characters.
style.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Timber: weathered dark brown (#5E4632) with carved paler edges (#8A6E4E). Stone: cool grey fieldstone (#8C8A82). Roofs: mossy green turf (#6B7A45) or straw thatch (#9A8656). Furs: cream and grey (#CFC5AE). Banners and cloth: saturated woad blue (#2F4E9C), no emblem. No text or logos.
